name: Deborah
title: Prophetess and Judge
summary: Deborah was the only female judge in Israel and a prophetess. She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel. She led Israel to victory over the Canaanite king Jabin and his commander Sisera, and composed a famous song of victory together with Barak.

keyEvents.title: Judge under the Palm
keyEvents.description: Deborah sat under the Palm of Deborah and judged Israel. The Israelites came to her to have their disputes settled.

keyEvents.title: The Call of Barak
keyEvents.description: Deborah called the commander Barak and gave him God's order to gather the army against Sisera.

keyEvents.title: Victory over Sisera
keyEvents.description: With Deborah's prophetic leadership, Barak defeated Sisera's army with its 900 iron chariots.

keyEvents.title: Jael's Heroic Act
keyEvents.description: Sisera fled and was killed by Jael, who drove a tent peg through his head - just as Deborah had prophesied that a woman would receive the glory.

keyEvents.title: Song of Victory
keyEvents.description: Deborah and Barak sang a famous song of victory, praising God for the victory and 40 years of peace in the land.
